modifications: Removed `import Utilities` (Project A module-namespace coupling).

Removed DAS.plot (L268-L282) and DAS.plot_single (L284-L287): convenience wrappers that imported Project A's `Utilities` and `preprocessing` modules; the underlying plotting functions are available directly as dasgauge.plotting.plot_das_data / plot_single.
Removed class MulDAS (L293-L348): multi-file concatenation, outside the requested scope.
Removed the unused local `RAW_GRP` in _read_silixa and the author-specific comment '# Paths from your example'.
Added module docstring with source attribution, __all__ = ['DAS'].
Algorithms, metadata keys, vendor dispatch and error messages are otherwise byte-identical to the source.
Removed the alias `curvelet_like_denoise = curvelet_denoise` (L512): backward-compatibility shim for Project A notebooks.
Removed load_and_preprocess (L670-L689): .npy sample loading tied to Project A's dataset layout.
Dropped the unused `Iterable` name from the typing import (L25).

integrate_strain_rate_fd docstring: replaced the Project A-specific sentence naming SpatialDAE training / 'model to collapse to pred=0' with a project-neutral statement of the same sign-convention consequence. Code unchanged.
curvelet_denoise docstring: added a note that the implementation is pure NumPy FFT and needs no external curvelet library. Code unchanged.
Added source-attribution header to the existing module docstring and an explicit __all__.
All algorithms, defaults, validation, scientific references (Candes et al. 2006; van den Ende et al. 2023; Zhang et al. 2025) and comments are preserved unchanged.

Replaced the top-level `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt` with a lazy `_pyplot()` helper (new code, not derived) so matplotlib is an optional dependency and the failure message names the `dasgauge[plotting]` extra.
Dropped unused imports carried by the original module: scipy.signal, datetime, collections.OrderedDict, re.
Removed commented-out alternative cmap/data lines inside plot_das_data's imshow call (L226, L228).
Extended plot_das_data's docstring with a one-line summary; existing text kept.
Excluded plot_das_comparison (L43-L198) and its helpers _PUB_COLORS/_STEP_DISPLAY/_fmt_step (L12-L41): a UNet-vs-raw SNR comparison figure specific to Project A's experiments.

Excluded draw_signal_rects (L308-L337), compute_snr (L340-L407), time_intervals_to_mask (L410-L461), snr_from_time_mask (L464-L510): video-frame/labels.csv-coupled metrics, outside the requested plotting scope.
Excluded downsample_data (L299-L305): superseded by preprocessing.downsample_time, which is the requested downsampling implementation.
Plot geometry, normalization, colormap, labels and return values are otherwise unchanged.

dependencies.notes: Curvelet processing needs no specialized package: curvelet_denoise is implemented directly on numpy.fft, so no optional curvelet extra exists. matplotlib is the only optional runtime dependency (extra: plotting), imported lazily. The test suite uses the standard library's unittest, so no test dependency is declared.
